name: Voyager
long_description:
Most AI tools are built for coding. Voyager is designed to get the best creative results from models like Opus, Astra and DeepSeek.

It comes bundled with free motion graphics, music and video editing tools - or, it can drive Blender, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Ableton and 100+ others.

From the team behind Moda (moda.app, 100k+ users).

launches.body:
Voyager is an open harness for video, music, games, and graphics.

It’s like Codex, but for creative work.

Voyager runs on your computer and lets you use models like Astra, Opus, and DeepSeek to steer 100+ AI image/video models and creative tools like Blender, DaVinci Resolve, Ableton, and Unity.

We’re the team behind [Moda](https://moda.app), a design tool loved by 100k+ people.

We’ve had a front-row seat as models have gotten extremely capable - and can handle complex work across storyboarding, video gen, sound design, editing, and finding archival footage. Voyager enables people to do this all from one place: no juggling API keys, providers, and apps.

<https://youtu.be/YJcy9zRJBRk?si=1wrVWXM6AIKfS6hQ>

# How it works

1\. Download Voyager at [voyager.so](http://voyager.so) and connect the tools, models, and subscriptions you already use.

2\. Describe what you want to do - edit existing footage, ideate on commercials for your product, make a launch video…

3\. Voyager works with you just like Codex. It comes with built-in apps for motion graphics, music, and editing - or it can use tools like Blender, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, etc on your computer

# Team

We're second-time founders, and previously worked on Dover YC S19 and Heap W13. 

Our team of 6 is obsessed with building tools for the next generation of creative work.
